sections.label: SportSG online booking system safeguards
sections.summary: SportSG enhanced its online booking system with a web application firewall and upgraded reCAPTCHA software to identify bots and prevent their bookings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: First, SportSG has enhanced its online booking system, including using a web application firewall and upgrading its reCAPTCHA software to better identify bots and prevent them from making bookings.

sections.label: SportSG scripter and on-seller penalties
sections.summary: SportSG suspended over 270 scripters and 180 on-seller accounts in two years and introduced harsher penalties from 1 July this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Third, SportSG has suspended more than 270 scripters and 180 on-seller accounts over the past two years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: To further deter these activities, harsher penalties have been introduced from 1 July this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: First-time offenders will now have their accounts suspended for up to six months, an increase from the previous three months, while a second infringement will result in a permanent termination of the account, rather than a six-month suspension.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: With the measures that SportSG has put in place, the volume of feedback regarding the use of bots and on-selling has reduced significantly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Offenders may use improved bot technologies to try to circumvent the safeguards but we will continue to enhance our systems and adopt best practices for better detection and prevention.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: We will also not hesitate to employ even stronger penalties against offenders if warranted.
